close_reason: Five .map(...).unwrap_or(false) sites converted to .is_some_and(...) in task.rs (2), memory.rs (2), lib.rs (1). The bead's recommendation to also convert the two .and_then(|v| v.as_bool()).unwrap_or(false) bool-arg-parsing sites was incorrect for canonical-template parity: jmap-mail-server email.rs:521-532 uses the exact same .and_then chain, so converting them in tasks-server would CREATE divergence rather than close it. Left intact. cargo fmt + clippy + test green.
description:
Five+ sites use `.map(...).unwrap_or(false)` or `.and_then(...).unwrap_or(false)` where the canonical sibling jmap-mail-server consistently uses `Option::is_some_and` (stable since 1.70, workspace MSRV is 1.88).

Sites in tasks-server:
- `lib.rs:486-489` — `.map(|lid| lid == task_list_id).unwrap_or(false)` → `is_some_and(|lid| lid == task_list_id)`
- `memory.rs:506-509` — `.map(|s| s == target.as_str()).unwrap_or(false)` → `is_some_and(|s| s == target.as_str())`
- `memory.rs:801-803` — `.map(|a| a.task_lists_with_tasks.contains(...)).unwrap_or(false)` → `is_some_and(|a| a.task_lists_with_tasks.contains(...))`
- `task.rs:33-37` — `.map(|s| s == "utcStart" || s == "utcDue").unwrap_or(false)` → `is_some_and(|s| ...)`
- `task.rs:258-261` — `.map(|m| m.iter().all(...)).unwrap_or(false)` → `is_some_and(|m| m.iter().all(...))`
- `task_list.rs:73-74` — `.and_then(|v| v.as_bool()).unwrap_or(false)` → `.is_some_and(|v| v.as_bool().unwrap_or(false))` (less clean here; alternative `== Some(true)` after `.and_then(|v| v.as_bool())`)

What goes wrong if it stays as-is: tasks-server is a cookie-cutter sibling of jmap-mail-server per AGENTS.md. The canonical-template propagation rule says siblings must mirror canonical idiom. `rg is_some_and crate-jmap-mail-server/src/ -c` shows ~14 hits across four files; tasks-server has 1 hit (`memory.rs`). The two siblings now diverge on a workspace-wide convention.

What idiomatic Rust would do: `Option::is_some_and` is the canonical way to express 'matches a predicate, default false' since the 1.70 release. The serious-Rust reader expects it, not the legacy two-combinator chain — which was the only option pre-1.70 and which clippy flags as `unnecessary_map_or` under sufficient pedanticness.
title: is_some_and not adopted — 5+ sites diverge from canonical jmap-mail-server
